commit_message:
FunctionSpecStore: name partials/callable instances, explicit names, validate=, refuse unservable callables (#13)

- names: __name__, the wrapped function's for a partial, the class name for a callable instance; or a {name: callable} mapping; two different callables under one name raise
- validate=True checks every function at construction (mk_rjsf_app does), so one bad function fails app construction, not the index page
- a function whose only parameters are required positional-only is refused (UnservableCallableError)
- variadic parameters are dropped by both i2.Sig's and inspect's names, so uiSchema autofocus no longer stays on a dropped field

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
